events.title: SKEW Demo v2.3 — Bug Fix Update
events.summary: SKEW Demo v2.3 is now live on both Windows and Mac. This is a bug fix update:* Fixed snow footprints disappearing in the final area.* Fixed a save corruption issue that could cause infinite loading when pressing Esc on the ending screen.* Removed a leftover half-functional jump input that made jumping feel "broken".Thank you to everyone who reported issues in the community hub — several of these fixes came directly from your reports.

events.title: SKEW Demo v2.2 — Now on Mac (Apple Silicon) + Fixes
events.summary: Hi everyone,SKEW Demo v2.2 is now live. Here's what's new:Mac SupportThe demo now runs natively on Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or later, macOS 12+). Fully notarized, downloadable straight from the store page. Intel Macs are not supported.Fixes- Windowed mode no longer oversizes beyond the screen on some display configurations- Pause menu background now dims properly- Fixed a one-frame camera jump at the end of the intro cinematicWishlistThere's now a Wishlist button at the end of the demo.
